plain: Deep feeling for another's suffering with a wish to help.

webster.text: A suffering with another; painful sympathy; a sensation of sorrow excited by the distress or misfortunes of another; pity; commiseration.

example.quote: Are the hearts of her citizens so deaf to compassion that they will not go to her relief?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
